early_game: use cheap removal only on engines/commanders/escalating threats
midgame: deploy Tor Wauki/planeswalkers when exposure is acceptable
treat Warstorm Surge as an independent top-end damage engine and recursion payoff
kaervek_window: prefer likely multiple opponent spells before next turn
priority_against_korvold: Warstorm Surge before a large creature/reanimation sequence
priority_against_rogshai: Warstorm Surge before large ETB/reanimation pressure
rules: Kaervek trigger is created when opponent casts a spell; countering that spell later does not remove the already-created trigger
